name: Ginger Noodle Soup
description: A flavorful and aromatic Asian-inspired soup featuring pork, ginger, and rice stick noodles in a savory chicken broth.
recipeIngredient: 1 pork chop, sliced into small pieces

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan brown pork over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce and soy sauce. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add rest of ingredients, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Garnish with green onion and coriander.

keywords: ginger noodle soup, Asian soup, pork soup

_similar.name: Mushroom Soup
_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: mushroom soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Tomato Macaroni Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring macaroni, vegetables, and a rich tomato broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in oil until tender.
Add stock, juice, and water. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

_similar.keywords: tomato macaroni soup, comfort food, pasta soup

_similar.name: Dad's Spaghetti
_similar.description: A comforting spaghetti dish with bacon, mushrooms, and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 tsp garlic salt or 1 to 2 minced garlic cloves

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti, drain, and set aside.
Brown bacon in a frying pan with garlic salt or minced garlic.
Remove bacon and most of the grease from the pan.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the same pan until tender.
Return bacon to the pan and add mushroom soup.
Stir and heat the sauce through, adding cheese and enough water to achieve the desired consistency.
Combine the sauce with cooked spaghetti and serve.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti, bacon, mushroom sauce, creamy pasta

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Beef
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Minestrone Soup with Shells
_similar.description: A hearty minestrone soup with small shell macaroni, kidney beans, and vegetables, topped with Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: ¾ cup (175 mL) small shell macaroni
1 can (14 oz/398 mL) red or white kidney beans, drained
3 cans (10 oz/284 mL each) chicken broth
1 can (19 oz/540 mL) tomatoes, coarsely chopped with liquid

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, cook the chopped bacon until crisp. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and cabbage; cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes.
Stir in the water, chicken broth, and tomatoes with their liquid. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Stir in the small shell macaroni and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes longer.
Add the kidney beans, garlic, and parsley to the soup; heat through.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

_similar.keywords: minestrone soup, pasta soup, Italian-American cuisine
